drafted_from: Three independent archived teachings about building a list, inviting early orders, and checking test-batch feasibility. The examples use invented products and numbers.
start_here: Help me draft a ten-unit test for washable pouches, without offering or taking payments yet.
no_lists_because: The workflow reads the evidence given in the prompt and returns a proposal without reading or changing any stored lists.
instructions: Say who wants the product and what they have actually done.
Bring the quote, delivery evidence, price, and cancellation terms, or name what is missing.
Read the capped draft or the next check. Do not publish or sell through this workflow.

worked_examples.title: A ten-pouch proposal
worked_examples.ask: Can I draft a small demand test before ordering washable pouches?
worked_examples.given: An invented dated quote, a ten-unit delivery slot and 31 sign-ups, none paid.
worked_examples.hands_back: A draft for the same ten units as cap and paid target, with terms and a no-stock plan on a miss.

set-one-batch-test-or-wait.audience: Owners who asked for a washable pouch at the maker fair
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.interest_evidence: A dated signup page records 31 interested readers; no orders yet.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.production_and_cost_evidence: Invented quote Q-12 lists ten pouches at 1,100 cents each and 250 cents each for packing; 2,400 cents leaves room for fees and the documented refund reserve.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.delivery_evidence: The maker and packing team confirmed their ten-unit limit and a July 14 dispatch slot in the example.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.delivery_terms: If all ten valid paid orders are kept at close, dispatch by July 14. If not, do not make this batch.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.cancellation_and_refund_terms: Cancel through the order confirmation reply route. Return payments on a missed threshold or late dispatch, with no loss of existing buyer rights.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.below_threshold: Order no stock. If real orders were separately authorized and accepted, return each payment and explain that the batch did not go ahead.

worked_examples.title: Wait for a delivery date
worked_examples.ask: Should I draft the same test when dispatch is unconfirmed?
worked_examples.given: An interested audience and a supplier with no confirmed dispatch date.
worked_examples.hands_back: A hold, naming the missing commitment and the request to check it.

set-one-batch-test-or-wait.audience: Owners who asked for a washable pouch at the maker fair
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.blocking_gap: The supplier cannot confirm a test-batch dispatch date.
set-one-batch-test-or-wait.next_check: Get a dated quote and a confirmed dispatch slot before drafting sale terms.
